metadata.article_title: Supreme Court to be a court of record

article.title: Supreme Court to be a court of record
article.content:
129Supreme Court to be a court of record



Article 129 · Part V


The Supreme Court shall be a court of record and shall have all the powers of such a court including
                the power to punish for contempt of itself.
